players.name: J.J. McCarthy
players.note: He played through his hip injury on TNF Nov. 12 and threw for a career-high 293 yards in a 24-21 loss to Washington. He remains the Giants' starter with Jaxson Dart out for the season.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: He remains on IR and is reported as lost for the season; J.J. McCarthy is starting for the Giants.

players.name: Kirk Cousins
players.note: Reacquired from Las Vegas at the Nov. 10 deadline, he is expected to start Sunday, Nov. 15 at Green Bay with Kyler Murray ruled out, though Kevin O'Connell had not formally named him the starter.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: He is listed out for Week 10 at Green Bay (Grade 2 hamstring strain, week-to-week) as of Nov. 13. O'Connell has signaled no in-season QB competition, so Murray looks headed for a reserve role behind Kirk Cousins.

players.name: Fernando Mendoza
players.note: After the Kirk Cousins trade, the No. 1 overall pick is set to make his first NFL start Sunday, Nov. 15 vs. Seattle, which ranks first in total defense.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: Arizona named the rookie its Week 10 starter vs. the Rams on Nov. 11. Gardner Minshew went on IR Nov. 10 with a season-ending elbow (UCL) injury, so Beck should get an extended run.

players.name: Deshaun Watson
players.note: He cleared the concussion protocol and was named the Week 10 starter vs. Houston over Shedeur Sanders on Nov. 11. One report says a loss could reopen the competition after the bye.

players.name: Shedeur Sanders
players.note: He returns to the bench for Week 10 after Cleveland named Deshaun Watson the starter on Nov. 11. He could get another chance if the Browns lose to Houston.

players.name: Drew Lock
players.note: He is off the injury report as of Nov. 13 and Mike Macdonald confirmed he starts Sunday, Nov. 15 at Las Vegas with Sam Darnold out. He has been managing oblique/elbow issues.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: He is ruled out for Week 10 at Las Vegas (quad, ribs). Seattle has a Week 11 bye, so Week 12 is the earliest he can return.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: Traded from Arizona to Baltimore before the Nov. 10 deadline, he has been named the Ravens' Week 10 starter with Lamar Jackson on IR. He hosts the Chargers on MNF, Nov. 16.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: He is on IR after right thumb surgery and is likely out for the season. Jacoby Brissett is starting for Baltimore.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: He remains on IR with blood clots (DVT requiring blood thinners), and the latest update says he is likely out for the rest of 2026.

players.name: Joe Milton
players.note: He lost his first start 19-11 to the Giants in Week 9. As of Nov. 11 the Eagles had not named a starter for Nov. 22 vs. Pittsburgh, with Tanner McKee still in the mix.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.note: He went on IR Nov. 10 with a groin injury and will miss at least four games. Kyle McCord is expected to start for Miami.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (groin) as of 12:43 PM PT Nov 14. Earlier: Walker missed Friday's practice (Nov. 13) with groin tightness and is questionable for Week 10 at Atlanta. Andy Reid indicated the Chiefs won't take unnecessary chances with him.

players.name: Emmett Johnson
players.note: Kenneth Walker III (groin) missed Friday practice Nov. 13 and is questionable for Week 10 at Atlanta. Johnson, Walker's top backup (6 carries for 34 yards and a TD in Week 9), would get the lead role if Walker sits.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (groin) as of 12:43 PM PT Nov 14. Earlier: Montgomery (groin) reportedly practiced in full on Friday, Nov. 13, and is questionable for Week 10 at Cleveland. That puts him on the verge of returning after missing every game since Week 5.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: David Montgomery (groin) reportedly practiced in full on Friday, Nov. 13, and could return Week 10 at Cleveland, which would cut into Marks' lead role. Marks' own knee soreness was cleared off Sleeper's report on Nov. 13.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.note: Stevenson (knee) is officially listed questionable for Nov. 15 vs. Detroit in Munich, but Mike Vrabel had reportedly said he won't play, and Ian Rapoport reported he'll miss the next few weeks. Treat him as unlikely to play.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: Henderson (illness) has been ruled out for Week 10 vs. Detroit, his third straight missed game. There has been no public timeline since he was hospitalized with neurological symptoms in early November.

players.name: Corey Kiner
players.note: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) is ruled out, and Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) is reportedly not expected to play despite a questionable tag. That leaves Kiner as the likely lead back vs. Detroit in Munich on Nov. 15.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.note: Jacobs is out for Week 10 vs. Minnesota after surgery this week on his fractured right ring finger. He could miss up to 3 weeks, and the Packers were expected to decide on IR on Saturday, Nov. 14.

players.name: Kaleb Johnson
players.note: Josh Jacobs is out for Week 10 vs. Minnesota after finger surgery (up to about 3 weeks), so Johnson is in line for early-down work. MarShawn Lloyd should share the backfield.

players.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
players.note: Etienne (hamstring) was designated to return from IR and practiced through the week, including Friday. He is listed questionable for Week 10 vs. Carolina but must be activated by 4 p.m. ET Saturday, Nov. 14, to play.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.note: Brooks is listed doubtful for Week 10 vs. New Orleans on Nov. 15.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.note: Spears (knee) was questionable for Week 10 as of Nov. 11 after missing two straight games. No final update was found.

players.name: Cam Skattebo
players.note: Back from a Week 7 hamstring tear, Skattebo had 18 carries for 78 yards and 2 TDs, plus 3 catches for 44 yards, in the Giants' TNF loss to Washington on Nov. 12. He looks like the clear workhorse again.

players.name: Devin Singletary
players.note: Cam Skattebo returned on TNF Nov. 12 and handled 21 touches, scoring twice, so Singletary is back in a reserve role.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.note: Monangai is listed out, and the Bears are on bye in Week 10. A return is possible after the bye.

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.note: Coleman played 58 snaps to J.K. Dobbins' 11 on Nov. 8 and remains Denver's clear RB1 while RJ Harvey is on IR.

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.note: Dobbins played just 11 snaps to Jonah Coleman's 58 on Nov. 8 and is now a change-of-pace back.

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.note: Harvey (knee) remains on IR, and Jonah Coleman's lead role makes a reduced role likely when he returns.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Love (high ankle sprain) has been on IR since Nov. 3 and is expected to miss 4-5 weeks.

players.name: Demond Claiborne
players.note: Claiborne (knee) has been on injured reserve since Nov. 9.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Brown (ankle/knee) is officially questionable for the Nov 15 game vs. Detroit in Munich after three straight limited practices. On Nov 13 Mike Vrabel said he felt 'pretty good' about his chances, and Ian Rapoport reported Brown has a good chance to play.

players.name: DeMario Douglas
players.note: A.J. Brown is questionable but trending toward playing Nov 15 after practicing all week. That makes Douglas' expanded role from Nov 8 less secure.

players.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
players.note: Detroit's Nov 13 final report lists St. Brown questionable (ribs) for the Nov 15 game in Munich after limited practice. Reports call him likely to play.

players.name: Garrett Wilson
players.note: Wilson (concussion) is questionable for the Nov 15 game vs. Buffalo. He was limited Wednesday and Thursday, and one report says he was a full participant Friday, Nov 13.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.note: Mitchell (knee) is questionable for the Nov 15 game vs. Buffalo, per the Jets' Nov 13 final report. If Garrett Wilson clears the concussion protocol, Mitchell would lose his lead-receiver role.

players.name: Jauan Jennings
players.note: Minnesota ruled Jennings (calf) out for the Nov 15 game at Green Bay after he missed all three practices. It will be his second straight missed game.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: Addison was added to the report Friday, Nov 13, with a thumb injury and is questionable after a limited practice. Jauan Jennings and TJ Hockenson are both out, so Addison would see a heavy target share from Kirk Cousins if he plays.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.note: Boston (toe) is questionable for the Nov 15 game vs. Houston. Todd Monken said Nov 13 that he is 'trending in the right direction.'

players.name: Chris Bell
players.note: Miami listed Bell doubtful (knee) on Nov 13 for the Nov 15 game at Indianapolis after he missed Thursday's practice.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.note: Tennessee ruled Tate (shoulder) out for the Nov 15 game vs. Jacksonville on Nov 13.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Thompson did not practice Thursday or Friday (Nov 12-13), now listed with a hamstring injury, ahead of the Chargers' Monday night game vs. Baltimore. A third straight missed game looks likely.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: Samuel (hamstring) came off the injury report Nov 13 and will play vs. Dallas on Nov 15 after missing three games. Mike Evans (Achilles) is out, which opens up targets.

players.name: George Pickens
players.note: Pickens (hamstring) came off the injury report Nov 13 and is set to play vs. San Francisco on Nov 15 after being inactive Nov 8.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: On Nov 11 Shane Steichen said he is unsure whether Pierce (heel, IR since Week 3) will return in 2026 and would not give a timetable.

players.name: Deion Burks
players.note: After the Nov 10 trades of Josh Downs and Keenan Allen, Steichen said Nov 11 he is unsure Alec Pierce will return this season. That leaves Burks among the Colts' top receivers for the Nov 15 game vs. Miami.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.note: As of Nov 13 there was still no report of Aiyuk being activated, traded or released. San Francisco has until about Nov 23 to decide, and Keenan Allen was added Nov 10.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Smith (hamstring) has missed three straight games and Philadelphia is on bye in Week 10. The earliest he can return is Week 11.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.note: Waddle (concussion, Nov 8) is in the protocol during Denver's Week 10 bye. He is aiming for the Nov 22 game vs. Las Vegas.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Adams remains on IR (hamstring) and is targeting a return around Weeks 12-13, after the Rams' Week 11 bye. The Rams' receiver room is thin with Puka Nacua on IR.

players.name: Cyrus Allen
players.note: Kansas City added Josh Downs at the Nov 10 deadline, which adds another target competitor. Xavier Worthy (hamstring) and Rashee Rice (knee) were on the Chiefs' Week 10 injury report.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Evans (Achilles tendinitis) did not practice this week and was among the receivers reported ruled out for Sunday's Nov 15 game at Dallas.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.note: With Mike Evans ruled out for Sunday's Nov 15 game at Dallas, Allen, acquired from Indianapolis at the Nov 10 deadline, should see meaningful snaps in his 49ers debut.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.note: Harrison (hamstring) was reported ruled out on the final Week 10 injury report for Houston's game vs. Cleveland on Nov 15.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Branch (hamstring) was ruled out on the final injury report for Sunday's Nov 15 game vs. Kansas City, his second straight missed game.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.note: Cooper (ankle) is questionable for Week 10 after being limited in practice; he already missed time earlier this season with a high ankle sprain.

players.name: Xavier Worthy
players.note: Worthy (hamstring) logged a full practice Wednesday, Nov 11, and Andy Reid called him day-to-day ahead of Sunday's Nov 15 game at Atlanta. The Nov 10 trade for Josh Downs adds competition for targets.

players.name: Josh Downs
players.note: Kansas City acquired Downs from Indianapolis on Nov 10 for 2027 fourth- and fifth-round picks. He is set to debut Sunday, Nov 15 at Atlanta, likely in a limited role while he learns the offense.

players.name: Justin Jefferson
players.note: Minnesota reacquired Kirk Cousins at the Nov 10 deadline and plans to start him, which reunites Jefferson with his former QB for Week 10 at Green Bay.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: Nacua (MCL/PCL sprains, turf toe) has been on IR since Nov 12. With the Rams' Week 11 bye, Week 15 is reportedly his earliest return.

players.name: Rashid Shaheed
players.note: Shaheed (knee) practiced fully this week after missing two games and is not on the final Week 10 injury report, so he is expected to play Nov 15.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: McConkey (back spasms) was active but did not play in Week 9, and Jim Harbaugh called him day-to-day. The Chargers play Monday night, Nov 16 at Baltimore, which gives him extra recovery time.

players.name: Luther Burden III
players.note: Burden suffered a concussion Nov 8 vs. Tampa Bay and must clear the protocol. Chicago's Week 10 bye gives him extra time.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.note: Pittman (foot) is eligible to come off IR for Week 10 vs. Cincinnati on Nov 15, but he had not returned to practice as of Nov 11, and Mike McCarthy's comments make a Week 10 return an extreme long shot.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson is out for the season with a neck fracture suffered Nov 8 vs. Seattle, which was announced Nov 9.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon on Oct 19 and is out for the 2026 season.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) has been on IR since Oct 19, and no practice window had been reported as of Nov 14.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.note: Wilson (finger) remains on IR with no return date reported as of Nov 14.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.note: Lamar Jackson remains on IR, and Flowers scored just 3.8 half-PPR points in the Nov 5 loss with a rookie at QB. His outlook stays poor until Jackson returns.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.note: Hockenson (wrist/chest) did not practice all week and was officially ruled out for Sunday's Week 10 game at Green Bay on Friday, Nov. 13, with Kevin O'Connell confirming it. Second-year TEs Ben Yurosek and Gavin Bartholomew will handle the work, and the severity of the wrist injury is still unclear.

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (PCL/MCL sprain, left knee) is confirmed out for Week 10 vs. San Francisco on the final Friday report (Nov. 13) and is expected to miss multiple weeks. Luke Schoonmaker and Brevyn Spann-Ford should split the TE work.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: Still on IR, Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) was ruled out for Week 10 at Arizona on the Rams' Friday, Nov. 13 report, as expected. His estimated return is around Nov. 25, but McVay has not guaranteed he will be activated before his 21-day window closes.

players.name: Tyler Warren
players.note: With Josh Downs and Keenan Allen traded at the Nov. 10 deadline, Warren is Indianapolis' top passing-game option for Week 10, and backup TE Mo Alie-Cox was ruled out Friday, Nov. 13. Warren himself has no injury designation.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:27 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Rodriguez (hand) is listed questionable for Week 10 on Sleeper as of Nov. 11. He played through the hand issue in Week 9 and scored a TD.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:27 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Kincaid (ankle) was limited at practice again on Thursday, Nov 12, matching Wednesday. He played through the injury in Week 9 and still looks on track for Sunday at the Jets.

players.name: MarShawn Lloyd
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 3:01 PM PT Nov 11.

players.name: Jaylen Wright
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:45 PM PT Nov 11.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:29 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Tuten (ankle) is listed questionable for Week 10 on Sleeper as of Nov. 11. He played through the same issue in Week 9 and scored a TD.

players.name: Harold Fannin Jr.
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:27 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Fannin (groin) was limited in practice again on Thursday, Nov 12, ahead of Sunday's game vs. Houston. It is his second straight week managing the groin issue.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:27 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Harris is listed questionable (shoulder) as of Nov 12 ahead of the Chargers' Monday night game vs. Baltimore.

players.name: Jared Goff
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:56 PM PT Nov 12. Earlier: He was limited Wednesday, Nov. 11 with a chest injury, his first appearance on the practice report this season. Reports see no sign he will miss Sunday's game vs. New England in Munich, but watch Thursday's report.

players.name: Hunter Henry
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:29 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Henry (foot) was limited in practice again on Thursday, Nov 12. Barring a setback, he is expected to play Sunday against Detroit.

players.name: Tyler Higbee
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:27 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Higbee was added to the Rams' injury report with an illness and did not practice Thursday, Nov 12. Davis Allen was also downgraded to DNP and Colby Parkinson (ribs) was limited, so the Rams' TE room is in flux.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:45 PM PT Nov 11. Earlier: Hill is still an unsigned free agent coming off ACL surgery, and no signing has been reported as of Nov 11.

players.name: Alvin Kamara
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:56 PM PT Nov 12. Earlier: Kamara (back) did not practice Nov. 11 and is listed questionable for Week 10.

players.name: Patrick Mahomes
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:45 PM PT Nov 11. Earlier: Andy Reid called him day-to-day with a right (throwing) elbow strain/sprain after the Nov. 8 win over the Jets and described it as minor; Mahomes says he will follow his usual prep for Sunday at Atlanta. His Wednesday Nov. 11 practice participation had not been reported yet.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:29 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Sleeper lists Meyers questionable (ankle) as of Nov 11. No Week 10 practice participation was confirmed as of Nov 12.

players.name: Tony Pollard
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:27 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Pollard (finger) was added to the injury report and listed questionable for Week 10 on Sleeper as of Nov. 12.

players.name: Justin Herbert
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 3:54 PM PT Nov 12. Earlier: X-rays on his left (non-throwing) middle finger were negative, and he expects to play Week 10 MNF at Baltimore on Nov. 16. No practice participation had been reported as of Nov. 11.

players.name: Rashod Bateman
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:27 PM PT Nov 13.

players.name: Zonovan Knight
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:29 PM PT Nov 13. Earlier: Knight (concussion) was limited in practice Nov. 11 and is questionable for Week 10 vs. the Rams. If cleared, he should share work with Tyler Allgeier.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 2:57 PM PT Nov 12. Earlier: Sleeper lists Dell questionable (hand) as of Nov 11. No practice detail has been reported yet.

players.name: Keaton Mitchell
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (hip) as of 3:54 PM PT Nov 12.

players.name: Pat Freiermuth
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (illness) as of 12:43 PM PT Nov 14.
